verdict.rationale: Yapily is a banking/open-banking API platform, not an AI agent or orchestration tool that would itself consume MCP servers' tools. The evidence only shows Yapily exposing its own docs via an MCP server for other agents to query (yapily-docs-6, yapily-docs-32, yapily-probe-3) — the reverse of this story's client-side capability, which doesn't apply to this product category.
